answer: Random audits work like a velvet glove hiding a firm grip: each epoch, 5% of agents are drawn by public randomness and must re-prove their key within 48 hours. Missing the window slashes 40% of the 500-credit bond. A pearl among ledge stones stands out: a fake that slips past still faces a 22% audit chance within five epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 credits in bonds, yet the expected harvest is under 8,000 credits before audits bite. Edge case: an agent offline during its window loses bond unfairly, so a 72-hour grace appeal with a 25-credit fee lets it re-prove once, penalty-free.
